translations.web: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
translations.bsb: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.
translations.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
translations.asv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But the prayer of the upright is his delight.
